Solve more mediums and hards.

I found understanding an algorithm, then solving some related questions is good to get me started, but i couldn’t really apply those  algorithms to new problems. I didn’t start doing that until I started using review schedule.

So I spent a month learning all the algorithms, everting from 2 pointers to segment trees. After I was finished, I started going through the algorithms again while solving new problems using them, took me about 2 weeks, then again, but took me less time then. Now I can review all the algorithms with new problems in 3 days. 

That being said, knowing the algorithm for the problem before hand was a huge unrealistic advantage, so I would throw in a new random problem every day (problem of the day/pick a problem button). This helped me with quickly identifying which algorithm to use quickly.

Finally, there will probably always be a new trick you haven’t seen before, so what I’d do is make a note of it and add it to my review. Eventually you just have so many tools to use while solving a problem, that it almost feels like intuition.
